summary: Iteration 11 — Filter modal date-reset bug (Turkish user report: 'tarih seçerken beni belli bir zaman sonra bugüne atıyor') is VERIFIED FIXED. Playwright test on mobile viewport (390x844) opened the FilterModal, typed 27/12/2025 into both start/end DD/MM/YYYY TextInputs, and observed the fields every 10s for 70s. Values remained '27/12/2025' at t+10, +20, +30, +40, +50, +60, +70s — NO reset to today. Apply then produced filter banner 'Tüm Şubeler · 27/12 - 27/12', 'Filtrelenmiş Veri / Otomatik yenileme durdu' indicator and dashboard totals Nakit=₺63,00 / Toplam=₺63,00 (matches backend cached financial_data for 2025-12-27, GENELTOPLAM=63.00). After Apply + additional 70s wait, banner + values STILL '27/12 - 27/12' / ₺63,00 (filter persisted, did not jump back to today). Backend GET /api/data/dashboard?sdate=2025-12-27&edate=2025-12-27 returned real cached day data (financial_data.row_count=1, GENELTOPLAM=63.00, financial_data_location.row_count=1) — backfilled dataset is intact and correctly per-day. All three refreshers (dashboard refreshData interval, useLiveData 30s interval via {paused}, fetchAllTotals 60s interval) are correctly paused while showFilterModal is true. No console errors, no red screen. Regression: dashboard live-mode indicator ('Canlı Veri · 1 dk') visible when modal is closed and no filter active — auto-refresh resumes normally.

rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE: Three concurrent auto-refreshers (dashboard refreshInterval useEffect at dashboard.tsx L76-84, fetchAllTotals 60s interval at L103-176, and useLiveData's internal 30s setInterval in useLiveData.ts) called setState on the dashboard while the FilterModal was mounted. Each parent re-render caused FilterModal props (currentFilters) reference to churn; the modal's useEffect keyed on `visible` was fine, but the DateTimePicker spinner on iOS re-mounts on parent re-render, snapping the wheel back to `new Date()` (today). REPRO: open filter modal on dashboard, set start/end to 2025-12-27, wait >30s → date wheel jumps to today. FIX (verified): useLiveData now accepts {paused} and skips initial fetch + clears interval when paused; both dashboard useEffects short-circuit with 'if (showFilterModal) return' and include showFilterModal in deps. VERIFICATION: with modal open, dates held for full 70s across all three refresher tick boundaries.
